title: Marker Grammar
description: Canonical grammar for [NEEDS CLARIFICATION:cl-N <question>] markers used in spec and plan documents.

cl_marker.description: A single NEEDS CLARIFICATION marker. ECMA 262 numbered groups: $1 captures the id (positive integer, no zero-padding), $2 captures the question text. Prefix is literal '[NEEDS CLARIFICATION:', followed by 'cl-' and a positive integer, at least one whitespace separator, question text (no ']'), and closing ']'.
